meta.author: Madis Jürviste
meta.title: AMT-Master DEF_en/DEF_et — reconstructed full changelog, initial generation to current master
meta.purpose: Audit trail for the machine-generated definitions: every DEF change between the initial LLM generation (Claude Opus, baseline snapshot 2026-06-12) and the canonical master of 2026-07-13, attributed to manual editing, the logged LLM-as-judge review pass, or the documented data-quality round.

snapshots.label: opus-baseline-2026-06-12
snapshots.note: Earliest DEF-bearing snapshot; same-day analyzed-tables/AMT-Master.json has no DEF fields, so this is at or very near the initial Claude Opus 4.5/4.8 generation output.
Intermediate snapshot; zero DEF changes vs baseline.

snapshots.label: review-2026-07-07
snapshots.note: State after the logged LLM review pass (Claude Fable 5 as judge; DEF-review_changelog_20260707.json) plus the unlogged manual edits of the same window.

snapshots.label: backup-2026-07-13
snapshots.note: Pre-DQ-round backup; zero DEF changes vs review-2026-07-07.

snapshots.label: current
snapshots.note: Canonical master as of 2026-07-13, after the DQ fix run (T1-T20 + D1-D12), the Sugu policy review and 12 manual record deletions (886 -> 870).

provenance_legend.manual-unlogged: Manual edit by the author (MJ) between 2026-06-17 and 2026-07-07; not in any changelog, reconstructed here by snapshot diff. Typically substantive interpretation decisions (resolving [uncertain] readings etc.).
provenance_legend.llm-review-logged: Correction from the logged LLM-as-judge review pass of 2026-07-07: all machine-generated DEFs critically reviewed by Claude Fable 5 against the six sources' attested German glosses plus DWDS/EKSS/Sonaveeb; per-change reason recorded in DEF-review_changelog_20260707.json and reproduced here.
provenance_legend.llm-review-logged-no-baseline: Same logged 2026-07-07 review pass, but the record was added to the master after the 2026-06-17 snapshot, so its pre-correction reading is not preserved in any snapshot (old = null).
provenance_legend.dq-round-2026-07-13: Data-quality review round of 2026-07-13 (T1-T20 + D1-D12 fixes, Sugu policy review); author-decided, applied per the documented review files.

caveats: DEF_en/DEF_et fields only; changes to other fields (Amt-Cat, Sugu, Teema, attestations) are diffable from the same snapshots but not included here.
Manual edits are reconstructed by exclusion (changed in snapshot diff but absent from the 2026-07-07 changelog); edits made and reverted between snapshots are invisible.
Record-level additions/removals per interval are listed in interval_summaries; the 12 record deletions of 2026-07-13 (886 -> 870, minus renames) appear there, not as DEF entries.

The June snapshots contain some duplicate Amt-Master-IDs (e.g. 921 records but ~907 unique IDs in the 2026-06-17 snapshot); diffing keeps the last occurrence per ID, so records_common counts are unique-ID counts, not raw record counts. ID renames (e.g. 'alw rahvas' -> 'alv rahvas') appear as an add/remove pair, not as a change.
